scale_cues: Large white square dinner plate (assumed ~26-28 cm across) seen from overhead; the salad covers roughly a fifth of the plate surface in a low, loose pile.
assumptions: Plate assumed to be a standard ~27 cm square dinner plate; no cutlery or hand visible for scale
Greens are a loose, low-density pile, so mass is low for the visible area
Reddish chunks at the left of the pile are assumed to be tomato; they could instead be roasted red pepper or beet
Dark glossy bits are assumed to be black olive; they could be dark leaf pieces or blackberry
Light vinaigrette assumed from the sheen and yellowish tint on the leaves; no pooled dressing visible
Image is low resolution, so small hidden items under the greens may be missed
